# Vectors

## Create Vectors

Create two vectors for blood pressure measurements. One vector is for pre-treatment measurements and the second vector is for post-treatment measurements.

```{r}
pre_treat <- c(130, 128, 116, 124, 133, 134, 118, 126, 114, 127, 141, 138, 128, 140, 137, 131, 120, 128, 139, 135)

post_treat <- c( 114, 98, 113, 99, 107, 116, 113, 111, 119, 117, 101, 119, 130, 122, 106, 106, 124, 102, 117, 113)
```

## Name Vector Elements

Add names to each of the blood pressure measurements for both the pre- treatment blood pressure measurements and the post-treatment blood pressure measureents

```{r}
names(pre_treat) <- paste("Subject", 1:20, sep = "_")
pre_treat

names(post_treat) <- paste("Subject", 1:20, sep = "_")
post_treat
```

## Vector Manipulations

```{r}
change_bp <- pre_treat-post_treat
change_bp
str(change_bp)
```

### Mean Decrease

```{r}
mean(change_bp)
```
